description: Validate an architecture-simulation document (the archsim format, spec: archsim.md next to llms.txt). Checks the JSON shape, known node kinds and edge references, and builds the graph with the type defaults. Returns {ok, error?, summary: {nodes by kind, edges, queues without consumers}}. Use it before archsim_simulate or before handing the JSON to a person.
name: archsim_validate
